summaryEn: Use a blackbody approximation to compare temperature and emission peak,building intuition for infrared background.

Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Target light and instrument background remain separate with explicit cooling boundaries.

quiz.question: 「目標與自身背景」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Target and self-background: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: λmax=2898/300=9.66 μm。真實表面放射率及觀測波段仍須另計。

optionsEn: λmax=2898/300=9.66 μm; real emissivity and observing-band integration remain separate.
Deliver temperature/peak table,observing band and limits from omitted emissivity.

quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Using Celsius produces severe peak errors; background tracking instrument temperature suggests self-emission. steps.title: 目標與自身背景 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Target and self-background · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「目標與自身背景」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Target and self-background and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
把攝氏溫度代入會嚴重錯估峰值；若背景跟儀器溫度走，先查自身熱輻射。
對照「目標與自身背景」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。冷卻效果須以目標波段背景與訊噪比驗證，峰值移出波段不代表該波段完全無輻射。
本階段必須重驗：目標光與儀器背景分開，冷卻對象有明確邊界。
steps.instructionEn:
Using Celsius produces severe peak errors; background tracking instrument temperature suggests self-emission.
Against the nominal Target and self-background result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Verify cooling through in-band background and SNR; moving the peak out of band does not eliminate in-band emission.
Reverify this criterion: Target light and instrument background remain separate with explicit cooling boundaries.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。把攝氏溫度代入會嚴重錯估峰值；若背景跟儀器溫度走，先查自身熱輻射。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Using Celsius produces severe peak errors; background tracking instrument temperature suggests self-emission.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 目標光與儀器背景分開，冷卻對象有明確邊界。
steps.checkEn: Target light and instrument background remain separate with explicit cooling boundaries.

steps.title: 目標與自身背景 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Target and self-background · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「目標與自身背景」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Target and self-background and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付溫度峰值表、觀測波段與未計入放射率的限制。
在交接件中加入「目標與自身背景」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：目標光與儀器背景分開，冷卻對象有明確邊界。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：用黑體近似比較溫度與輻射峰位置，建立紅外線背景的量級直覺。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver temperature/peak table,observing band and limits from omitted emissivity.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Target and self-background: Target light and instrument background remain separate with explicit cooling boundaries.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Use a blackbody approximation to compare temperature and emission peak,building intuition for infrared background. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。目標光與儀器背景分開，冷卻對象有明確邊界。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Target light and instrument background remain separate with explicit cooling boundaries.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

steps.checkEn: Target light and instrument background remain separate with explicit cooling boundaries.
